meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (Annual Survey of Industries)
meta.revisionPolicy: ASI results are final on release; occasional revisions get a fresh vintage.
meta.product: Annual Survey of Industries, NIC 1998 block
meta.coverage: Every state and UT, all industries, every indicator, 1998-99 to 2003-04 (NIC 1998 block)
meta.note: The NIC-1998 classification block, a separate ruler from every other block (never joined). Values as published: money in ₹ lakh (nominal; fuel values in ₹ thousand where the source says so), counts plain, mandays in thousands. Survey years are financial years, dated at April of the first. A class missing in a year was not reported separately that year.
